consequence.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the `experimental.ruler.enable-api` option is removed, so an environment that still sets it no longer has it honoured.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the `experimental.ruler.enable-api` option; operators should use `ruler.enable-api` instead.
